label: Connect an App
description: Connect one of 2,700+ apps (Slack, Google Sheets, Notion, Gmail, Airtable, HubSpot…) through Pipedream's managed auth, pick one of its actions, and run it on your own connected account. The action's fields load dynamically and support variable tags.

config.name: appSlug
config.description: Selected Pipedream app key/slug (e.g. slack, google_sheets, notion).

config.name: toolConfig
config.description: Values for the action's dynamic fields. String fields support variable tags.

config.name: authStatus
config.description: Connection state of the user's account for this app (connected|expired|error|none).

produces.reference: [Input from {id}] for the whole action result; [[<field>] from {id}] for a field of the action's JSON result

consumes.note: Each toolConfig field is a distinct input and supports variable tags.
